notes: Inputs are recipe ingredients and recognized machine fuels or fluids supplied from outside. Outputs are products not consumed by another included process. Check belt, pipe, and robot connections in-game; this analysis does not simulate routing or throughput.

target.assumptions: Normal quality, no modules or beacons, both lanes supplied, adequate inserters and electricity. Capacity calculation only.
target.singleEntranceDecision: 60 plates/s demand exceeds one red or blue belt. A single turbo inlet would add Gleba/tungsten transport requirements; retain two red inlets to preserve the original operational tier.

parentProof.laneProof: Every connected component carries one material. Each ordinary belt has at most one incoming entity: direction changes are sole-input corners, not competing side loads. Unfiltered splitters preserve the two lane identities while distributing each lane across their two outputs; reciprocal underground pairs preserve lanes. Both lanes remain available through each branch. No merged feeds, priorities, filters, chest sharing or mixed-material lanes are accepted.
